name: shinchantw_cbt_android_ticket_ad_compare_v3_20260729_184152_670848
sql:
-- Android-only D0 comparison through 18:00 Asia/Shanghai.
-- Ticket 10238: item_change stores before/after; use before > after as ticket consumption.
WITH
tc_blacklist AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
sg_blacklist AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
sg_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
tc_android AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
sg_android AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
raw AS (
  SELECT 'TC Android 2026-07-29' AS cohort, v."#account_id" AS account_id, v."#user_id" AS user_id, v."#distinct_id" AS distinct_id,
    v."#event_name" AS event_name,v."#event_time" AS event_time,v.product_id,v.sandbox,v.is_freebuy,v.status,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS stage_type,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS item_id,
    TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].before AS DOUBLE) AS item_before, TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].after AS DOUBLE) AS item_after
  FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN tc_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id INNER JOIN tc_android a ON v."#user_id"=a.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-07-29 18:00:00'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'SG Android 2026-05-08',v."#account_id",v."#user_id",v."#distinct_id",v."#event_name",v."#event_time",v.product_id,v.sandbox,v.is_freebuy,v.status,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER),CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT),TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].before AS DOUBLE),TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].after AS DOUBLE)
  FROM ta.v_event_13 v LEFT JOIN sg_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id INNER JOIN sg_country c ON v."#user_id"=c.user_id INNER JOIN sg_android a ON v."#user_id"=a.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 18:00:00'
),
cohort_users AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,MAX_BY(distinct_id,event_time) AS distinct_id
  FROM raw WHERE event_name='new_role' AND account_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2
),
events AS (SELECT r.* FROM raw r JOIN cohort_users c ON r.cohort=c.cohort AND r.account_id=c.account_id),
ticket AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN item_before>item_after THEN item_before-item_after ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_consumed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN item_after>item_before THEN item_after-item_before ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_gained,
    MAX_BY(item_after,event_time) AS last_ticket_balance
  FROM events WHERE event_name='item_change' AND item_id=10238 GROUP BY 1,2
),
main_stage AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,event_time,item_id AS stage_code
  FROM events WHERE event_name='stage_fight' AND stage_type=1001
),
first_stage_attempt AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,event_time,stage_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort,account_id,CAST(FLOOR(stage_code/10) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY event_time) AS attempt_n
  FROM main_stage WHERE MOD(stage_code,10)=1
),
boss_fail AS (SELECT DISTINCT cohort,account_id FROM first_stage_attempt WHERE attempt_n=2),
ad_views AS (
  SELECT cohort,distinct_id,COUNT(*) AS successful_ad_views
  FROM raw WHERE event_name='game_ad_impression' AND TRY_CAST(status AS INTEGER)=1 GROUP BY 1,2
),
profile AS (
  SELECT c.cohort,c.account_id,c.distinct_id,
    CASE WHEN c.cohort LIKE 'TC%' THEN 100501 ELSE 102901 END AS no_ad_product_id,
    COALESCE(t.tickets_consumed,0) AS tickets_consumed,COALESCE(t.tickets_gained,0) AS tickets_gained,t.last_ticket_balance,
    CASE WHEN b.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS boss_fail,
    COALESCE(a.successful_ad_views,0) AS successful_ad_views,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name='charge' AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payer,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name='charge' AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE) AND CAST(TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT)=CASE WHEN c.cohort LIKE 'TC%' THEN 100501 ELSE 102901 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bought_no_ad
  FROM cohort_users c LEFT JOIN events e ON c.cohort=e.cohort AND c.account_id=e.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ticket t ON c.cohort=t.cohort AND c.account_id=t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN boss_fail b ON c.cohort=b.cohort AND c.account_id=b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ad_views a ON c.cohort=a.cohort AND c.distinct_id=a.distinct_id
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9
)
SELECT cohort,'overview' AS section,'all Android D0 new-role users' AS segment,
  COUNT(*) AS users,ROUND(100.0*SUM(payer)/COUNT(*),2) AS payer_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(boss_fail)/COUNT(*),2) AS boss_fail_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(tickets_consumed),2) AS avg_ticket_consumed,ROUND(AVG(tickets_gained),2) AS avg_ticket_gained,
  ROUND(AVG(last_ticket_balance),2) AS avg_last_ticket_balance,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN last_ticket_balance=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS last_balance_zero_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(successful_ad_views),2) AS avg_successful_ad_views,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN successful_ad_views>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS ad_viewer_rate_pct,
  SUM(bought_no_ad) AS no_ad_buyers,ROUND(100.0*SUM(bought_no_ad)/COUNT(*),2) AS no_ad_buy_rate_pct
FROM profile GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort,'boss_fail_x_ticket',CASE WHEN boss_fail=0 THEN 'no boss fail' WHEN last_ticket_balance IS NULL THEN 'boss fail + no ticket snapshot' WHEN last_ticket_balance=0 THEN 'boss fail + ticket balance 0' ELSE 'boss fail + ticket balance >0' END,
  COUNT(*),ROUND(100.0*SUM(payer)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(boss_fail)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(tickets_consumed),2),ROUND(AVG(tickets_gained),2),ROUND(AVG(last_ticket_balance),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN last_ticket_balance=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(successful_ad_views),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN successful_ad_views>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2),SUM(bought_no_ad),ROUND(100.0*SUM(bought_no_ad)/COUNT(*),2)
FROM profile GROUP BY 1,3
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort,'ad_behavior',CASE WHEN bought_no_ad=1 THEN 'bought permanent no-ad' WHEN successful_ad_views=0 THEN 'no successful ad view' WHEN successful_ad_views<=3 THEN '1-3 successful ad views' ELSE '4+ successful ad views' END,
  COUNT(*),ROUND(100.0*SUM(payer)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(boss_fail)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(tickets_consumed),2),ROUND(AVG(tickets_gained),2),ROUND(AVG(last_ticket_balance),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN last_ticket_balance=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(successful_ad_views),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN successful_ad_views>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2),SUM(bought_no_ad),ROUND(100.0*SUM(bought_no_ad)/COUNT(*),2)
FROM profile GROUP BY 1,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3;
